Welcome to the Artemis Accords, Côte d'Ivoire 🇨🇮
 
Côte d'Ivoire is the 75th country to sign the Artemis Accords. In doing so, they commit to a common set of principles for a safe, peaceful, and prosperous future in space. https://t.co/lT9f9Kooo2 https://t.co/9Wf1T1ndGz

Meet Crew-14!

NASA astronauts Kayla Barron and Chris Birch, JAXA (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency) astronaut Makoto Suwa, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Arutyun Kiviryan will lift off to the @Space_Station no earlier than March 2027. https://t.co/lxGnP5SJKP https://t.co/9NxfvVrlct
